data_quality_selection: At least 500 valid aligned pre-2019 returns and no absolute pre-2019 daily return above 50%; future returns do not determine membership
later_listing_treatment: not admitted to the fixed starting universe; allocation stays cash
missing_report_treatment: hold to next observed usable release
fx: USD daily quote strictly prior label, max age 5 calendar days; SGD unchanged; timing approximation disclosed
benchmark: ES3 official NAV total return reconstructed with issuer distributions
short_availability: ALL BORROWABLE ASSUMPTION, not historical evidence
costs: 20 bps one-way; 3% annual borrow; 40 bps doubled-cost scenario
liquidity: vendor split-adjusted price/volume pair; split/volume basis not independently verified
unresolved: missing delisted histories, current-vendor identity mapping, rights/merger adjustments, borrow availability, raw publication metadata
